sets.q: Which problem can you just know as a basic fact?
no: 19 is bigger than 10. Break it apart.
Both numbers are too big for a basic fact.
67 needs two boxes.

sets.q: Break apart in your head: 14 × 7 = 70 + 28 = ____
What is 573 × 4?
answers: two thousand two hundred ninety two

sets.q: What is 27 × 32?
Astrid wrote 76 × 8 = 560 + 42 = 602. Is her work valid? Type valid or not valid.
sets.why: 6 × 8 is 48, not 42. The right answer is 560 + 48 = 608, so her work is not valid.

sets.q: Fishlegs wrote 39 × 8 = 240 + 63 = 303. Fix the blunder. What is 39 × 8?
Astrid added 7 again and again for 13 × 7 and got 84. She lost count. What is 13 × 7 really?
Berk has 6 pens with 27 sheep each and 5 pens with 19 sheep each. How many sheep in all?
sets.no: Multiply for each kind of pen, then add.

sets.q: Which answer is reasonable for 37 × 23?
no: Too small: 30 × 20 is already 600.
Too big: 40 × 30 is only 1,200.

sets.q: A triumphant Viking feels …
sets.why: Triumphant means proud and happy after winning or succeeding.
no: Careless describes a blunder, not a win.
Triumphant means sure and proud, not confused.
Tired is not the same as proud after winning.

sets.q: Which sentence uses method correctly?
choices: A method is the answer you write at the end.
Gobber's method for sharpening a sword has five careful steps.
Snotlout's method was the careless slip he made in the ones box.
sets.why: A method is a way of doing something, step by step.
no: The answer is the product. A method is the way you get there.
A careless slip is a blunder, not a method.

sets.q: Which word means to look at something very closely to find any problem?
sets.why: To scrutinize is to look at something very closely to find any problem.
no: Triumphant means proud and happy after winning.
Optimal means the best possible choice for the job.
Deliberate means done on purpose, after thinking.

sets.q: Which problem can you just know as a basic fact?
no: 13 is bigger than 10. Break it apart.
Both numbers are too big for a basic fact.
43 needs two boxes.

sets.q: Break apart in your head: 19 × 6 = 60 + 54 = ____
What is 348 × 7?
answers: two thousand four hundred thirty six

sets.q: What is 39 × 24?
Snotlout wrote 59 × 4 = 200 + 36 = 236. Is his work valid? Type valid or not valid.
Astrid wrote 67 × 9 = 540 + 56 = 596. Fix the blunder. What is 67 × 9?
Gobber added 9 again and again for 14 × 9 and got 135. He lost count. What is 14 × 9 really?
The fleet has 8 boats with 24 shields each and 3 boats with 46 shields each. How many shields in all?
sets.no: Multiply for each kind of boat, then add.

sets.q: Which answer is reasonable for 62 × 18?
no: Too small: 60 × 10 is already 600.
Too big: 70 × 20 is only 1,400.

sets.q: A valid answer is one that is …
choices: correct and based on good reasons
the fastest guess you can make
sets.why: Valid means correct and based on good reasons.
no: An accident is not a reason. That is closer to a blunder.
That is triumphant.
A fast guess is not the same as correct reasoning.

sets.q: Which sentence uses optimal correctly?
choices: The optimal method for 7 × 6 is to add 7 six times.
For 9 × 8, the optimal method is just knowing the fact.
Hiccup felt optimal after his nap.
sets.why: Optimal means the best possible choice for the job.
no: Adding 7 six times is slow. For a basic fact, just knowing it is optimal.
Optimal describes the best choice, not a feeling.

sets.q: Which word means done on purpose, after careful thinking?
sets.why: Deliberate means done on purpose, after careful thinking.
no: Triumphant means proud and happy after winning.
A blunder is a careless mistake, the opposite of careful.
A method is a way of doing something.
